subject: Schedule change: condensed onsite window for Backend Eng candidate
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@gmail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 18:12:00 -0400
Subject: Scheduling: Backend Engineer onsite - arrival window and options

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We have you scheduled for an onsite interview in SF the week of Sep 11. A quick logistics question: can you confirm when you expect to arrive into SF? We have two typical tracks depending on arrival time:

- Full day (4.5–5 hours): on‑site technical sessions + lunch with team (preferred)
- Condensed on‑site (2.5–3 hours): a reduced technical loop + brief takehome followup / remote whiteboard to cover the rest

If you foresee arriving late (after 1pm local), we can compress the loop into a 3‑hour window starting at 2pm, or convert the final session to a remote exercise. We can also reimburse reasonable same‑day travel costs if that helps (please keep receipts).

I've attached the resume we have on file and a placeholder calendar invite — once you confirm arrival ETA we will lock in the exact times. If the immigration appointment you're attending runs later than expected, let us know and we'll propose alternatives.

Attachments: Aisha_Qureshi_Resume.pdf (resume stub), travel_itinerary.jpg (itinerary photo)

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Backend Engineer onsite - arrival window and options

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks for the note. Quick update: my visa stamping appointment in NYC on Sep 11 unexpectedly got moved earlier (they only had one slot) and I'm now landing in SFO that afternoon at 3:10pm (ETA customs + ground ~4:30pm). I sincerely apologize for the late notice — I only got the appointment confirmation late last night.

I can do the condensed 3‑hour window starting at 5pm if that still works (happy to stay flexible), or we can shift some of the technical loop to a remote session the next morning. I would appreciate reimbursement for any same‑day travel or ride (I can upload receipts).

If neither of those options work we can look at a full reschedule — whatever is easiest for the interviewers. Please advise.

Best,
Aisha Qureshi

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Backend Engineer onsite - arrival window and options

Thanks for the heads up, Aisha — and no worries about the logistics.

We can accommodate a condensed onsite starting 5pm. Operational notes for the panel:

- Marissa: please run the system design loop (30–40m) as planned.
- Karthik: would you be OK doing the coding pair at 5:50pm but remote (screen share) so we can keep the in‑office portion shorter?
- I'll take the behavioral and product fit at 6:30pm (30m).

Priya — please send an updated calendar invite for a 5:00–8:00pm condensed window and mark the coding slot as \"hybrid / remote\". Also confirm with Aisha that recording for internal debrief is OK (we keep recordings internal and delete after review).

If Aisha prefers, we can push the coding entirely to a takehome exercise with a synchronous followup, but we should avoid a full reschedule if possible. Also confirm the receipts process for same‑day travel reimbursement — if she can upload to the travel form we can route to Finance quickly.

Thanks all — I can flex later into the night if needed.

—Vanessa

Subject: Missed check‑in: Backend onsite (Sep 11 condensed window) — next steps

Hi Aisha —

We missed you at the office for the condensed window and your onsite check‑in. I wanted to quickly check if everything is okay and whether you made it into town — no pressure, just hoping you're safe.

If you ran into travel delays and still want to proceed, we can:
- Offer a remote coding session this afternoon (60m) plus a 30m behavioral chat tomorrow; or
- Provide a takehome coding exercise with a scheduled 30m followup next week.

If you need to cancel and reschedule for a later date, please tell us your availability and we'll reopen slots — we understand these things happen. Also, if you did incur same‑day expenses and would like reimbursement, please upload receipts here: https://docs.company.com/forms/travel-reimburse — I'll fast‑track the approval.

Quick ask: could you reply within 24 hours so we can confirm interviewer availability? If we don't hear back we'll assume you'd like to reschedule and will share open dates.

Take care,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
